result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations decomposing quadratic forms of the type λz(z+μx+νy)+(z+ax+by)(z+x/a+y/b) into products of linear factors plus an xy term, with conditions on the parameters α, β, ρ and characteristic-like 0/1 triples in the margin, likely connected with theta characteristics and singular quadrics.

methods.what: Decomposition of a pencil of quadratic forms into product of two linear forms plus an xy term
Conditions on α, β for the factorization
Rationalizing a sum of square roots relation among p,q,r,s with p+q+r+s=0
Linear relation (cyclic identity) among parameters λ, λ', λ'' and γ, γ', γ''
Values of ρ making a combination of the forms degenerate
Symmetric coefficient matrix of quadratic form and its determinant expansion
